environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running legacy Flask monolith in us-east-1 VPC. PostgreSQL RDS instance in same subnet with static credentials stored in /etc/app/db.env. Security group allows inbound 8080 from ALB. DB user 'app_readonly' has SELECT on all tables including users.api_key column. No query analysis or WAF in front of the GraphQL endpoint. Credentials are static, rotated manually during quarterly maintenance windows.
